description: The same house battery bank as `house`, seen by a second source: the WattCycle 314Ah BMS read over BLE by driver-wattcycle (the Venus SmartShunt is `house`). Two sources for one bank: the Primary battery setting picks which instance is the headline. Synthetic, not captured: values sit slightly off the shunt's (a BMS and a shunt never agree exactly) and follow the same load steps as `house`. No time-to-go: a BMS does not report it.
